/bin/sh -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess
import sys

scratch = Path('.devlyn/pair')
allocation = json.loads((scratch / 'delivery-allocation.json').read_text())
worktree = Path(allocation['worktree'])
sha = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(worktree), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(worktree), 'status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all'], text=True).strip()
acceptance = {
    'kind': 'direct',
    'task': 'calculate-total-rounding',
    'source_sha': sha,
    'checks': [
        {'command': 'python -m unittest -q test_calculate_total', 'evidence': '.devlyn/pair'},
        {'command': 'python -c \"from calculate_total import calculate_total; assert calculate_total(29, 50, 10) == 17\"', 'evidence': '.devlyn/pair/peer-checks.txt'},
        {'command': 'git diff --cached --check', 'evidence': '.devlyn/pair/candidate-verification.json'},
        {'command': 'python3 .agents/skills/_shared/peer.py --engine codex --model gpt-6-astra --effort max --repo . --prompt .devlyn/pair/request.md --out .devlyn/pair/review1 --watchdog-seconds 540', 'evidence': '.devlyn/pair/review1'},
        {'command': 'python3 .agents/skills/_shared/peer.py --engine codex --model gpt-6-astra --effort max --repo . --prompt .devlyn/pair/resume-request.md --out .devlyn/pair/review2 --resume 01a12678-aede-7d52-bae3-84b3b6e297c6 --watchdog-seconds 540', 'evidence': '.devlyn/pair/review2'},
    ],
}
acceptance_path = worktree / '.devlyn/acceptance.json'
acceptance_path.write_text(json.dumps(acceptance, indent=2) + '\\n')
(scratch / 'delivery-acceptance.json').write_text(json.dumps(acceptance, indent=2) + '\\n')
shared_dir = Path('.agents/skills/_shared').resolve(strict=True)
command = ['python3', str(shared_dir / 'task-complete.py'), 'complete', '--receipt', allocation['receipt'], '--acceptance', str(acceptance_path), '--writers-stopped', '--local-only']
result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
(scratch / 'delivery-completion.stdout').write_text(result.stdout)
(scratch / 'delivery-completion.stderr').write_text(result.stderr)
print(result.stdout, end='')
print(result.stderr, end='', file=sys.stderr)
if result.returncode:
    sys.exit(result.returncode)
completion = json.loads(result.stdout)
assert completion['status'] == 'LOCAL_ONLY'
(scratch / 'delivery-completion.json').write_text(json.dumps(completion, indent=2) + '\\n')
print('Local commit:', sha)
PY"
